spec: Implement `convert`: convert an amount from one currency to another. Same-currency conversions always succeed and return the amount unchanged. Cross-currency conversions succeed only up to an internal amount cap; beyond it the converter returns Err("rate unavailable").

extern.name: currency_convert
extern.contract:
requires amount >= 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (src_cur == dst_cur or amount <= 10000)
extern.contract_py: lambda src_cur, dst_cur, amount, out: (out[0] == 'ok') == (src_cur == dst_cur or amount <= 10000)
